notes: Page states these styles apply to all LSB Industries brands; this page's style text and examples are identical to the shipped ClimaCool/ClimateCraft/ClimateMaster pages, so the shared system is source-established. The shipped style is carried in full (not via usesStylesOf), following the LSB precedent, so this file stands alone. Only page Style 2 ships, year-only: its year digits are text-verified while its month letter mapping is chart-only. Page Style 1 HELD: its year is a single letter whose mapping is chart-only (CLIMATEMASTER-1-Serial-Number.jpg), and its week-position text is ambiguous (3rd & 4th digits give week 11 under character counting vs week 13 under digit-only counting, both valid, so no counting is falsified and neither year nor week is encoded). Page Style 3 HELD: year is 1st (decade) + 2nd (year) letters and month is the 3rd character, both mappings chart-only (Friedrich-Style-3.png). See report for image-pass items.

styles.notes: Page 1-based positions 1-2 = year digits, converted to 0-based half-open [0,2]; 92 resolves to 1992 under the century rule (2092 is future). Month is the 3rd character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image CLIMATEMASTER-2-Serial-Number.jpg, so month is null and the style ships year-only per established precedent.
